decisive_items: Shows a compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction consistent with an atypical compound nevus
Score: -7.1 (where scores from -16.7 to -2.1 are consistent with a benign nevus)
response.rationale: Histopathology and gene expression testing support the diagnosis of an atypical compound nevus, while features concerning for melanoma are outweighed by evidence for a benign process

rejected.why: Gene expression testing suggests a benign nevus, contradicting the diagnosis of melanoma
